Use cases/Operations

Account closure review against your pre-closure checklist

Before an account is closed, the agent checks balances, pending items, holds and open alerts against your list, and sends anything that does not clear to a reviewer.

Book a demoSee how it runs

Works with

  • Custom REST
  • Core banking · via Custom REST
  • Case system · via Custom REST

and any system with an API via Custom REST

What is an account closure review?

  • The procedure

    Before an account closes, operations checks that nothing is left open: balances, pending payments, standing orders, holds, disputes and monitoring alerts. A closure requested while an alert is open goes to a reviewer under your policy. The operator closes the account only once each check clears.

  • What the agent does

    • Pulls balances and pending items from core banking through Custom REST

    • Checks the case system for open alerts

    • Re-screens the customer in ComplyAdvantage

    • Prepares the closure checklist or the list of items to settle

  • What your team decides

    • Closing the account, which an operator does

    • Holding a closure linked to an open alert

    • Approving the message to the customer about open items

    • Escalations to your MLRO or compliance officer

Setting up the Closure Review Agent

Connect your systems

Read accounts and pending items from core banking through Custom REST, re-screen in ComplyAdvantage, and keep the closure checklist in Google Drive.

  • Custom REST
  • Core banking · via Custom REST
  • Case system · via Custom REST

Write the rules

Your pre-closure checks are written in CEL, and the agent runs all of them on each request.

Sample data
account.open_items.size() > 0Wait for items
alerts.open.size() > 0Ask a reviewer
account.open_items.size() == 0 && alerts.open.size() == 0Clear for closure

Add reviewers where the procedure says

A person decides on any closure that does not clear the list, and the decision and reason are logged.

Account closure · v1.1

Start it from the event

A closure request from core banking or your service desk starts the review by webhook. Another webhook fires when an open item settles, and a daily schedule lists closures still waiting.

  • Inbound webhook · closure requested
  • Daily at 06:00 · closures waiting on open items
  • Inbound webhook · open item settled

Version and evaluate

Test a clean closure, one with a card dispute still open and one that follows a monitoring alert. Each version of the closure procedure has to pass all three before publishing.

Questions about account closure review automation

Does the agent close accounts?

No. It runs the checks and prepares the checklist. An operator closes the account once each check clears.

What if the closure follows a monitoring alert?

The run pauses for a reviewer, as in the third example. Whether the closure goes ahead is their decision, made under your procedure.

Does it re-screen the customer?

Yes, in ComplyAdvantage, as one of the checks on your list. The result is saved with the closure checklist.

Controls your auditors will ask about

These controls apply to each agent you build. Sample data

    • Admin
    • Author
    • Reviewer
    • Auditor

    Role-based access

    Admin, Author, Reviewer and Auditor roles, scoped to each workspace.

    • 417c2e…
    • 42a91f… ← 7c2e
    • 4303d8… ← a91f

    Hash-chained audit log

    Each entry carries the hash of the one before it. Verifying the log recomputes the chain and flags entries that no longer match.

  • v1.1v1.2v1.3Published

    Versioned specs

    Each run records the exact version it followed; old versions stay readable.

  • * * * * * * * *vault/sumsub/key

    Secrets in a vault

    Steps point to a vault path, and the key stays in the vault.

    • Signed delivery✓ accepted
    • Unsigned delivery✕ rejected

    Signed webhook triggers

    Unsigned or stale deliveries are rejected before a run starts.

  • SandboxLive

    Sandbox before live

    New versions run on test data first. Going live is a separate step.
